action_command: Runs this command on the server (as the console user):
action_full_perm: FULL permission (shell and writes on the server)
action_resume: Resumes the session of the agent that asked
admins_decide: This request runs an action on the server: only administrators decide.
agent_conversation_title: Opens the conversation of the agent that created the notification
already_decided: This request has already been decided (or has expired).
archive_read_title: Removes from the inbox everything already read and not waiting for you
continue_agent_claude: continue the agent conversation in Claude Code
discuss_title: Takes this request to the Claude tab prompt to discuss it before deciding
empty: No notifications. Scheduled tasks, scripts and agents post alerts and approval requests here (see scripts/engine/inbox/SKILL.md).
expires: Expires {when}; with no decision by then, it counts as rejected.
message_not_found: Notification #{id} not found (it may have been deleted by the archive cleanup).
no_auto_action_pre: No automatic action: the requester checks the decision
no_decide_perm: Your group is not allowed to decide requests.
note_label: Note (optional, sent along to the agent/script)
note_placeholder: e.g. you can delete them, but keep the November .tar files
open_claude_title: Takes the notification to the Claude tab prompt
pop_empty: No notifications. When a scheduled task or an agent finds something (or needs your approval), it shows up here.
subtitle: alerts, notices and approval requests from scheduled tasks, scripts and agents
title: Notification Center
